title: 2D–2D NiMo-LDH/MXene hybrid electrocatalyst for durable and efficient overall water splitting at high current densities
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01414J, Paper
Samruddhi V. Chauhan, Kinjal K. Joshi, Parikshit Sahatiya, Gopala R. Bhadu, Pratik M. Pataniya, C. K. Sumesh
Hydrothermally grown NiMo-LDH/MXene on NF was studied for hydrogen and oxygen production, achieving faradaic efficiencies of 94% and 80%, respectively.
